## Individual Project Markdown Endpoints
- [Multi-Tenant RAG Platform (AnyAssist)](https://dev-s-t.github.io/projects/anyassist.md): Google ADK agents, LiteLLM cost/routing gateway, logical vector namespace isolation.
- [Privacy-First On-Prem RAG (A2A Protocol)](https://dev-s-t.github.io/projects/privacy-rag.md): Inverted RAG topology over A2A protocol for compliance-sensitive clients.
- [WhatsApp Dispatch Automation](https://dev-s-t.github.io/projects/whatsapp-dispatch.md): B2B group dispatch for Dubai luxury transport client + musician community vertical.
- [VOAG Enterprise Voice AI SaaS](https://dev-s-t.github.io/projects/voag.md): 1,000+ daily calls in Mr. LADs app, sub-200ms latency, UAE LAN SIP modem architecture.
- [Hireups AI Avatar Interviewer](https://dev-s-t.github.io/projects/hireups.md): Photorealistic video avatar interviewer built on Gemini Realtime & LiveKit GCP for MGS via Quantashift.
- [MAGe Media Generation Engine](https://dev-s-t.github.io/projects/mage.md): Google Veo, Playwright brand crawler, Cartesia voice, Subreddit trend intelligence, session `contextvars` cost accounting.
- [UniBias Live Attention Tracker](https://dev-s-t.github.io/projects/unibias.md): Real-time browser-side computer vision attention tracking.
- [Blood Bank Demand Forecasting System](https://dev-s-t.github.io/projects/blood-bank.md): IEEE-published SARIMA/XGBoost dynamic micro-expiry simulation.
